spanish: Y fortaleceré el corazón de Faraón, y perseguirá detrás de ellos, y me glorificaré en Faraón y en todo su ejército, y Egipto conocerá que yo *soy* Jehová. Y hicieron así.
grammarChanges: conocerán Egipto → Egipto conocerá (singular agreement so Egipto reads unambiguously as the subject, not as the object of an unnamed plural subject)
que yo Jehová → que yo *soy* Jehová (supplied copula in italics for the verbless Hebrew clause כִּי אֲנִי יְהוָה)
readerNote: Changed plural conocerán to singular conocerá so Egipto reads unambiguously as the subject rather than as an implied-they's object, and supplied the italicized copula *soy* for the verbless clause; me glorificaré was left unrepaired because no grammar-only fix restores the niphal cohortative's volitive force without interpreting.
